activity.notes: Ashot I the Great was the first Bagratid king of restored medieval Armenia. The Oxford Handbook of Byzantine Studies lists the Armenian royal sequence from 885 with Ashot I reigning 885–890. ATLAS records only his kingship, not the preceding prince-of-princes phase.

sources.title: Rulers — The Oxford Handbook of Byzantine Studies
sources.citation_text: The Oxford rulers table lists Ashot I the Great as ruler of Armenia from 885 to 890.

sources.title: Byzantine crown of the Bagratuni kings — Pan-Armenian Digital Library
sources.citation_text: The Armenian Academy of Sciences publication states that Ashot I Bagratuni received a crown and was crowned king in 885.
